title: bromus hordeaceus var. simplicissimus
intro: Bromus hordeaceus var. simplicissimus, commonly known as Cheat Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The health benefits of Bromus hordeaceus var. simplicissimus are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
